method: 60 Hz decode of complete actual canvas recording; area-filtered to maximum dimension 384 px; linear sRGB relative luminance 0.1 opposing-transition hysteresis; separate >=0.8 saturated-red / >0.2 CIE 1976 UCS distance pairs; rolling one-second per-pixel counts and sliding one-third-frame fields. Field areas sampled every third frame.
limitations: Not PEAT/Harding or an independently validated conformance analyzer.
Downsampling and VP9 encoding may hide small fast transitions; full-resolution and physical viewing geometry require review.
Per-pixel frequency/area screening does not certify concurrently moving flash groups, every possible interaction or all physical displays.
Recorded world only; DOM controls are reviewed separately.
